title: Pastors fear AI misreading Scripture; their people trust it more
subtitle: U.S. practicing Christians (November 2025) and U.S. Protestant pastors (December 2025)
caption: Nearly all pastors (94%) worry about AI misinterpreting Scripture. Practicing Christians are more worried than pastors that AI will replace spiritual leaders, yet far more willing to trust it with their spiritual growth.
note: The first three rows are the share expressing concern about each outcome. The last row is a different question: the share who would trust AI with growing spiritually (for practicing Christians, completely or somewhat). Barna surveyed U.S. adults, including practicing Christians, and U.S. Protestant pastors in separate online samples. Barna figures drawn by Christian Curator from published numbers.
